title: Quantum Possibilities, Honesty, and the Power of Integrity
summary: Opening with a reflection on how quantum physics demonstrates that our thoughts define our future possibilities, President Hughes expands on the Ten Commandments regarding honesty and integrity. He shares a personal business narrative illustrating absolute trust built over 25 years and pulls powerful insights from Job, the stripling warriors, Hyrum Smith, and President Spencer W. Kimball. The text serves as a call for missionaries to perform regular personal inventories, casting out hypocrisy and cultivating uncompromised, lifelong integrity.
